text:
Predicates:
Japanese(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Top10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Sells(x, y) ::: x sells y copies.
LegendOfZelda ::: the Legend of Zelda.
Premises:
Japanese(company) ∧ Created(company, LegendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (Japanese(y) ∧ Created(y, x))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Game(x) → (Sells(x, millionPlus) → Top10(x))) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
Sells(LegendOfZelda, millionPlus) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
¬Top10(LegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
